replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Warns are there as reference to moderators that shows them the history of the player and can be used to issue the appropriate punishment.

For example, if someone has a warn for spam and a mod sees this on their profile then they have the leverage to issue out a more harsh punishment if the player re-offends.

The OP is wrong when it said that a warn is not a punishment.
When you break the rules, the lightest form of punishment is a warn, taking that off players' punishment pages would serve no purpose.

Also, if warns are removed (which would be a bad move) people would then be complaning that kicks are displayed on the punishment page as that would be the new lightest form of punishment.

Removing warns would do more bad than good for Avicus.

If you have warns on your page, then instead of complaing about them, how about you learn from them and become a better player as a result?
